# Abdul Rahaman S  
Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist  
abdulabd1132000@gmail.com

[github.com/11abd](https://github.com/11abd)  

## Summary  
Detail-oriented Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist with extensive experience in developing machine learning models and deploying robust solutions in production environments. Proficient in designing end-to-end ML pipelines, leveraging deep learning and NLP techniques, and ensuring model explainability. Currently seeking to transition into a full-time ML engineering role, bringing a strong foundation in data-driven decision-making and a passion for innovative AI applications.

## Skills  
- **Languages:** Python, SQL  
- **Deep Learning & NLP:** TensorFlow, Keras, Transformers, LLM, RAG  
- **MLOps & Deployment:** MLflow, DVC, Docker, GitHub Actions, FastAPI, CI/CD  
- **Cloud & Systems:** AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker), Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104), Git, PostgreSQL  
- **Machine Learning & Data Science:** Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, Model Evaluation, Feature Engineering  

## Projects  
### Fraud Detection System – End-to-End MLOps Project  
**Technologies:** Python, XGBoost, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, MLflow, Docker, GitHub Actions, SHAP  
- Developed an XGBoost-based fraud classifier on highly imbalanced transaction data (~0.17% fraud rate), significantly improving fraud recall compared to baseline models.  
- Implemented business-driven threshold tuning, enhancing recall-precision balance beyond default probability thresholds.  
- Achieved high ROC-AUC scores in the 0.9s range while prioritizing recall for fraud detection use cases.  
- Integrated SHAP for model explainability, providing feature-level insights for both global trends and individual predictions.  
- Deployed a FastAPI inference service, utilizing Docker for containerization, with automated CI checks and experiment tracking via MLflow.  

### RAG Chatbot (NLP / LLM Project)  
**Technologies:** Python, FastAPI, Ollama, Sentence-transformers, ChromaDB  
- Created a fully offline RAG system capable of answering queries based on PDFs and lecture videos.  
- Implemented hybrid retrieval methods combining vector similarity (ChromaDB) and keyword-based scoring for improved accuracy.  
- Developed an idempotent ingestion pipeline encompassing PDF parsing, Whisper-based transcription, chunking, and embeddings.  
- Integrated local LLM inference (Ollama) with strict context enforcement to minimize hallucinations and enhance answer relevance.  

## Professional Experience  
### Ciklum (Pixellot AI Sports Production)  
**Support Engineer**  
Mar 2024 – Present | Chennai  
- Provided support for a large-scale sports production platform utilized by global B2B clients.  
- Monitored system and stream health using Grafana dashboards, proactively identifying anomalies to prevent downstream failures.  
- Diagnosed pipeline failures, data inconsistencies, and configuration issues through application and system log analysis.  
- Conducted acceptance testing for new installations, ensuring system stability prior to client handover.  
- Collaborated with R&D teams to escalate recurring and critical issues, contributing to long-term system reliability.  
- Gained exposure to production systems and algorithm behavior, driving a deeper specialization in machine learning and applied AI development.  

### Infosys  
**System Engineer**  
Oct 2020 – Mar 2024 | Chennai  
- Resolved Windows OS and enterprise application incidents within SLA using ServiceNow.  
- Managed patching, vulnerability remediation, and system administration across servers and workstations.  
- Supported Office 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.  
- Contributed to operational improvements through proactive monitoring and issue prevention.  

## Certifications  
- AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)  
- ITIL V4 Foundation – Service Management Best Practices  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)  
- Business Communication Excellence – Level 5  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)  

## Education  
**University of Madras**  
Bachelor of Computer Applications  
2017 – 2020 | Chennai, India  

**Dhanalakshmi School**  
Higher Secondary  
2017 | Chennai
